// Every page's frame: a skip link, the header with the site's name and navigation (a menu button on a phone), the
// page itself in <main>, and the footer.
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { site } from '../content'
import { Link, useRoute } from '../lib/router'
import { ThemeToggle } from './ThemeToggle'

export function Layout({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { path, hash } = useRoute()
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false)

  // A new page starts at its top (or at the part its link points to), and the phone menu closes.
  useEffect(() => {
    setMenuOpen(false)
    const target = hash !== '' ? document.getElementById(decodeURIComponent(hash.slice(1))) : null
    if (target !== null) target.scrollIntoView()
    else window.scrollTo(0, 0)
  }, [path, hash])

  return (
    <div className="shell">
      <a className="skip-link" href="#main">
        Skip to content
      </a>
      <header className="header">
        <div className="container header__inner">
          <Link to="/" className="brand">
            <span className="brand__mark" aria-hidden="true" />
            <span>{site.name}</span>
          </Link>
          <nav aria-label="Main" className={menuOpen ? 'nav nav--open' : 'nav'} id="main-nav">
            <ul>
              {site.nav.map((item) => (
                <li key={item.to}>
                  <Link to={item.to} className="nav__link">
                    {item.label}
                  </Link>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </nav>
          <div className="header__actions">
            <ThemeToggle />
            <button
              type="button"
              className="icon-button menu-button"
              aria-expanded={menuOpen}
              aria-controls="main-nav"
              aria-label={menuOpen ? 'Close menu' : 'Open menu'}
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen((open) => !open)}
            >
              <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.8" strokeLinecap="round" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      <main id="main" tabIndex={-1} className="main">
        {children}
      </main>
      <footer className="footer">
        <div className="container footer__inner">
          <p>{site.footer}</p>
          <ul className="footer__links">
            {site.nav.map((item) => (
              <li key={item.to}>
                <Link to={item.to}>{item.label}</Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>
  )
}
